name: Nguyen Quoc Nghi
intro: I build backend systems where the details matter — payments, data integrity, and reliable APIs.
about: At CIT Technology Solutions, I work on production APIs with NestJS and Laravel: payment reconciliation, concurrent wallet operations, database schemas, and query optimization. I also build personal projects in Go, exploring asynchronous jobs, worker pools, testing, and container delivery.
education: B.Sc. Information Technology — Ho Chi Minh City University of Industry and Trade (HUIT), June 2026

experience.summary: Production backend development across payment, ride-hailing, ERP, and POS applications. Selected contributions are detailed below; Go work is listed separately as personal projects.

projects.name: Go AI Job Gateway
projects.summary: An asynchronous gateway for long-running AI jobs, with bounded concurrency and provider fallback.
highlights: HTTP 202 submission, polling/SSE results, bounded workers, per-job timeouts, and graceful shutdown.
Atomic Redis Lua rate limiting, device-scoped job access, and interchangeable stores.
15 tests run with the race detector; CI checks and Kubernetes probes/HPA configuration.

projects.name: Unicorn
projects.summary: Backend for a cyber-cafe chain: PC-session billing, wallet top-ups, F&B orders, and revenue reports.
highlights: Unified payment IPN/callback handling with idempotency and per-minute reconciliation.
Implemented multi-device admin sessions with Jest e2e tests.
Tuned slow reporting queries with EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

projects.name: HappyGo
projects.summary: CMS and mobile APIs for a ride-hailing and delivery platform.
highlights: Resolved approximately 60 tickets across trips, coupons, wallets, and stores.
Added concurrency protection against duplicate driver-withdrawal approvals.
Implemented Vietnamese search without diacritics and province-scoped access.

projects.name: Xuat An Kieu My ERP
projects.summary: Data models and ERP workflows for an industrial-catering business.
highlights: Designed schemas and modules for HR/timekeeping, menus, purchasing, stock, supplier pricing, and food-safety checks.
Added RBAC, Vietnamese/English localization, and Excel import/export.
Improved query structure through N+1 removal and indexing.

projects.name: PosNail
projects.summary: Address-data migration for a US nail-salon POS management system.
highlights: Replaced free-text addresses with indexed state/city IDs using a 29,880-city dataset.
Preserved data across order, export, and audit-log flows.
